description: Golden conformance vectors covering object (pure, nested, optional paths, message sub-patterns, SQL-refused message json holes) and args matchers.

vectors.description: pure object spec extracts nested keys with transforms
object spec matches when input carries extra unreferenced keys beyond required shape
object spec fails match when top-level required shape key is missing
object spec fails match when nested required shape key is missing
object spec fails match when intermediate path node is a primitive instead of object
object spec fails match when intermediate path node is null
object spec fails match when intermediate path node is an array
object spec traverses 4-level nested path and hyphenated key name
optional object field paths absent from input yield missing status and short-circuit transforms
present object key with JSON null value matches shape and yields missing status
object spec with message sub-pattern extracts both from.path and from.hole fields
object spec fails match when message sub-pattern does not match msg text
object spec fails match when message sub-pattern path holds a number
object spec fails match when message sub-pattern path holds null
object spec whose message sub-pattern contains a json hole is SQL-refused

sql.reason: Specs containing a json hole cannot be compiled to ClickHouse RE2 extractGroups because RE2 cannot match balanced brackets (§5, T2.1.5).

vectors.description: object spec with message json hole fails match on invalid JSON in msg (still SQL-refused)

sql.reason: Specs containing a json hole cannot be compiled to ClickHouse RE2 extractGroups because RE2 cannot match balanced brackets (§5, T2.1.5).

object field expecting string rejects nested object value with type_mismatch
